overload.title: Your System is Overloaded.
overload.body: Modern life is running corrupt scripts in your mind. Endless tabs, decision fatigue, and chronic stress are consuming your bandwidth. It's time for a system reboot.

architecture.label: THE FOUNDATION
architecture.title: The Architecture
architecture.softwareP1: Your mind is running outdated software. Constant notifications and infinite feeds are consuming your cognitive resources.
architecture.softwareP2: Awake OS teaches you to audit your internal algorithms, reclaim mental bandwidth, and install cleaner protocols for focus and presence.
architecture.hardwareP1: Your nervous system is the hardware running the operating system. Chronic stress has left it in a permanent state of high alert.
architecture.hardwareP2: Through precise 60-second somatic resets, Awake OS shows you how to ground the hardware and restore natural regulation.

modules.label: SYSTEM PROTOCOLS
modules.title: The Modules
modules.intro: Twelve precise protocols for auditing and rewriting your internal operating system.
modules.m01Body: Recognizing when your system has crashed and how to perform an emergency shutdown before permanent damage occurs.
modules.m02Body: Booting into a minimal state where only essential processes run, allowing you to isolate and remove corrupted mental patterns.
modules.m03Body: Identifying which background processes are consuming your attention and how to forcefully end them with precision.
modules.more: + 9 MORE PROTOCOLS IN THE COMPLETE SYSTEM
